package.author: Shinichiro Goto
package.description: Self-hosted, Japanese-first shared memory for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Antigravity).

en-US.author: Shinichiro Goto
en-US.description: Self-hosted, Japanese-first shared memory for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Antigravity).
en-US.longDescription:
kioku gives all your AI coding agents on all your machines one shared memory: sessions are
captured by lifecycle hooks, the next session starts with the previous handoff, and past
decisions are searchable (Japanese and English) through MCP. On Windows kioku runs as a
client of your own kioku server; join it with the one line `kioku invite` prints on the server.
en-US.name: kioku
